Album description
If anyone can document bassline’s endemic behaviour in current club music, it’s UKF. Standing firm at the forefront of the bass music revolution since 2009, they’ve watched all manner of low frequencies worm, wriggle and writhe their way into almost every genre of dance music possible. As bass music’s leading curator, UKF have sold in excess of hundreds of thousands of albums over the past 2 years. UKF Drum & Bass 2013 includes tracks and mixes from Sub Focus, John Newman, Brookes Brothers, Friction, Rockwell, Camo & Krooked, Noisia, Rollz, Fred V & Grafix, Hamilton and many more.
